title: 8 Hour Circle Island Jeep Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
•A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Weight Restrictions of between 225-250 Pounds per passenger
Age Limit between 7-70 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: OUR MOST POPULAR TOUR...This 8 HOUR CIRCLE ISLAND TOUR is designed to give visitors a full experience of Oahu. Oahu’s diverse landscapes are some of the most breathtaking in the island chain, with endless points of interest to explore. We'll explore all the sights and sounds of the South, East and North Shore of the island of Oahu.
